verdict.rationale: Supabase's evidence covers Realtime (Broadcast/Presence/Postgres Changes), local dev CLI, RLS, storage, and self-hosting, but there is no mention of offline-first client SDKs, local persistence, conflict resolution, or automatic sync-on-reconnect for offline writes — this is a fundamentally different capability from server-push Realtime. Missing for 10: offline local database/cache on client, queued writes while disconnected, conflict resolution strategy, and documented reconnect-sync behavior.
